senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Self-governed, subdued, restrained.
2 Attentive, fixed or intent upon.
3 Constant, permanent.
4 Ascertained, certain, fixed.
5 Inevitable.
6 Positive, definite.
7 Permeable, what may be spread through or over.
n. adv. (-तं)
Always, constantly.
subst.
Elementary or crude matter, the recipient of attributes or properties.
E.
नि before यम to restrain, affix क्त.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Of subdued mind or spirit.
E.
नियत, and मानस the mind.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Self-regulated, self-controlled or restrained.
E.
नियत, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Abstemious, moderate.
E.
नियत, and आहार food.

f. (-तिः)
1 Destiny, luck, good or bad fortune.
2 A religious duty or obligation.
3 Self-command, self-restraint.
(-ती)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
नि before यम to refrain, affix क्तिन् or क्तिच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of restrained or subdued passions.
E.
नियत controlled, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be restrained, checked, controlled, &c.
E.
नि before यम to restrain, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Who or what restrains, governs, or guides.
m. (-न्ता)
1 A charioteer, a coachman.
2 A ruler, a governor, a master.
3 A punisher.
E.
नि before यम to restrain, affix तृच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Checked, restrained, governed, guided.
E.
नि affirmative particle, यम to restrain or check, affix क्त.

m. (-मः)
1 Agreement, contract, engagement, assent, promise.
2 Any religious observance voluntarily practised, as fasting, watching, pilgrimage, praying, &c.; voluntary penance, meritorious or supererogatory piety.
3 A religious observance or obligation in general.
4 Certainty, ascertainment.
5 Rule, precept.
6 Usage, practice.
7 Common places in poetry, conventional expression, as notice of the Birch in describing the Himālaya, of the Sandal tree in describing the Malaya mountain, the whiteness of vesture, blackness of hair, the cry of the peacock in the rains, of the Koïl in spring, &c.
E.
नि before यम to refrain, affix अच्.

m. (-मः)
1 Religious act, penance, fasting, &c. especially if an act of supererogation.
2 Restraint.
E.
नि before यम to restrain, affix घञ्: see नियम.

n. (-नं)
1 Precept, fixed practice or rule.
2 Binding.
3 Restraining, checking.
E.
नि before यम to restrain, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being sought or obtained.
2 Being led or conducted.
3 Being taken or taken away.
E.
नी to obtain, शानच् aff. यक् inserted.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Observing fixed rules.
2 Relating to or corroborative of a rule.
E.
नियम, and पर attached to.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Regulated, prescribed.
2 Governed, guided.
3 Checked, restrained.
4 Bound, confined.
E.
नि before यम to check, affix क्त.

ind.
Having restrained.
mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
To be checked or restrained.
E.
नि before यम to govern, ल्यप् or यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
Causing to fall or descend: see निपातन.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Guiding, governing, what regulates or restrains.
m. (-कः)
1 A boatman, a sailor; but variously applied to one who rows, who steers, or who keeps a look-out from the mast head.
2 A pilot, a helmsman.
3 A charioteer.
E.
नि before यम to go or stop, affix ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Engaged in, applying or attached to.
2 Authorized, called, appointed.
3 Directed, enjoined, commanded.
4 Ascertained.
5 Fastened or attached to.
E.
नि before युज to join, affix क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Authorizing, appointing.
E.
नि before युज to join, शानच् aff.

ind.
1 Having joined or attached to.
2 Having put to or harnessed.
E.
नि, युज to join, ल्यप् aff.

mn. (-तः-तं)
1 A million.
2 A hundred thousand.
E.
नि before यु to join, affix क्त.

n. (-द्धं)
Close fight, personal struggle.
E.
नि before युद्ध fight, contest.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be appointed or authorized.
E.
नि, युज to join, affix तव्य.

m. (-गः)
1 An order or command.
2 Authority, appointment.
3 Occupation, appointed duty.
4 Effort, exertion.
5 Ascertainment, certainty.
6 Incidence, occurrence.
E.
नि before युज to join, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
The object of any appointment, authorized act or duty.
E.
नियोग, and प्रयोजन cause.

m. (-धिः)
The form of appointing to any act or duty.
E.
नियोग, and विधि rule.

m. (-र्थः)
The object of an authorized act or appointment.
E.
नियोग, and अर्थ object.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
1 Engaged in any pursuit, closely attached to it or engrossed by it.
2 Appointed, authorized, entrusted with authority, &c.
m. (गी)
A minister, a deputy, an agent, &c.
E.
नियोग, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Fit to be appointed or authorized, able or fit for a duty.
m. (-ग्यः)
A master.
E.
नि before युज to join, यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Ordering, commanding, directing.
2 Uniting, attaching to.
3 Urging, impelling.
E.
नि before युज to join, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Entrusted with, appointed to.
2 Directed, ordered.
3 Impelled, urged to, instigated.
4 Joined or attached to.
5 Suited or adapted to, connected with, &c.
E.
नि before युज to join, क्त affix, with इट् augment.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be attached or joined to.
E.
नि, युज to join, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
1 To be attached to.
2 To be appointed to or employed in.
3 To be commanded, instigated, &c.
m. (-ज्यः)
A servant.
E.
नि before युज to join, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-द्धा)
1 A cock.
2 A combatant, a wrestler, a boxer.
E.
नि near, युद्ध to fight, तृन् aff.
